text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready for work and begin my job at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. In the evening, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. Then I have dinner, relax, and read a book before bed. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel healthy, focused, and ready for each new day.
